page: Google Cloud Platform a2-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server configured with eight NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs providing a total of 320 GB of VRAM. The host system features 96 vCPUs powered by dedicated Intel Xeon x86_64 processors running at 2.2 GHz across 48 physical cores. System memory totals 680.0 GB, yielding approximately 7.08 GB per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance type, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile characterized by top-tier LLM inference capabilities and strong multi-core processing, contrasted by weak single-core execution. The server achieves top-tier status in LLM inference prompt processing across small, medium, and large models, alongside strong multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and high memory bandwidth. Conversely, single-core benchmarks, such as single-threaded gzip compression and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25% of performance.

Given the high density of GPU accelerators and massive memory capacity, this server represents a specialized hardware class optimized for resource-intensive parallel computing. The absence of local storage requires external storage provisioning, which is a key architectural tradeoff. The instance is highly suited for large-scale machine learning workloads, including LLM training and inference, ray tracing, and high-throughput database operations, but is less cost-efficient for workloads reliant on single-threaded CPU performance.
